mapper.sql: select id, meeting_id, topic_id, ext_info, order_no, deleted, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from bus_meeting_topic
mapper.select: select t.id, t.title, t.report_people as reportPeople, t.report_unit as reportUnit, mt.order_no as orderNo from bus_meeting_topic mt left join bus_topic_info t on mt.topic_id = t.id where mt.meeting_id = #{meetingId} and mt.deleted = 0 and t.deleted = 0 order by mt.order_no, mt.create_time
mapper.delete: update bus_meeting_topic set deleted = #{meetingId} where meeting_id = #{meetingId} and deleted = 0
mapper.insert:
insert into bus_meeting_topic(meeting_id, topic_id, ext_info, order_no, deleted, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark) values
(#{item.meetingId}, #{item.topicId}, #{item.extInfo}, #{item.orderNo}, #{item.deleted}, #{item.createBy}, #{item.createTime}, #{item.updateBy}, #{item.updateTime}, #{item.remark})
